origins.section: SAIFI Counts Interruptions and SAIDI Counts Minutes, per Customer Served
Expected Failures Avoided Turn Into Every Non-Financial Measure
Financial Benefit Is NPV, and Each Consequence Is Counted Once

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-indices: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-indices: SAIFI = sum N_j / N_T, SAIDI = sum r_j N_j / N_T; 'Both indices count only sustained interruptions... longer than five minutes.' 2,000/50,000 = 0.04; 180,000/50,000 = 3.6; the 3-minute outage is momentary.
recorded.prompt:q-customer-minutes: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-customer-minutes: CMI = F x C x M ('customer-minutes avoided'); 0.25 x 8,000 x 150 = 300,000. The page says these are expected values (worked example: 0.574 x 12,000 x 240).
recorded.prompt:q-double-count: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-double-count: 'the value function does not add F x cof as a fifth measure. Adding it would count the same dollars twice, and a doubly counted effect gets twice the weight.'

recorded.prompt:q-indices:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-indices:a: 'The 20,000 customers of the 2-minute outage count in neither index: a momentary outage is not a sustained interruption.'
recorded.prompt:q-indices:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-indices:c: 'The denominator is all customers served, not the customers who were interrupted; dividing by those instead gives CAIDI's denominator.'
recorded.prompt:q-indices:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-indices:d: The momentary outage 'count[s] in neither index', so it adds no minutes to SAIDI either.
recorded.prompt:q-customer-minutes:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-customer-minutes:a: 'These are expected values: P003 will not prevent 0.574 of a failure... 0.574 is the average over many possible futures.' F is multiplied in, not treated as 1.
recorded.prompt:q-customer-minutes:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-customer-minutes:b: CMI_{i,t} = F C M: customer-minutes include both customers and minutes ('times 240 minutes more, 1,653,216 customer-minutes').
recorded.prompt:q-customer-minutes:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-customer-minutes:c: Same formula CMI = F C M; customers are part of customer-minutes.
recorded.prompt:q-double-count:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-double-count:b: Repair cost is already inside NPV, so it is not a separate consequence; 'they are a double count and must go.'
recorded.prompt:q-double-count:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-double-count:c: 'Adding it would count the same dollars twice... gets twice the weight it deserves'; it does carry weight.
recorded.prompt:q-double-count:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-double-count:d: The page's rule is not to add it: 'does not add F x cof as a fifth measure'; a double count 'must go.' It never mentions offsetting through weights.
